# September 2026 is for quantum: IEEE Quantum Week 2026, IWQC, QRE, and beyond


[@larawatson](https://pennylane.ai/profile/larawatson)


It's official: quantum is taking over Toronto in September.


Both the PennyLane and Xanadu teams will be at IEEE Quantum Week (of course) and hosting not one, not two, but *three* epic quantum events:


- unitaryCON (invite-only) 🧑‍💻
- [The International Workshop on Quantum Compilation (IWQC)](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/8th-international-workshop-on-quantum-compilation-tickets-1989017233087) 🔗
- [The International Workshop on Quantum Resource Estimation (QRE)](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/the-8th-international-workshop-on-quantum-resource-estimation-qre2026-tickets-1994373479765?lid=0mz72f0w7r5x&utm_source=braze&utm_medium=ebml&utm_campaign=clpo_ceex_lcm_fad_mec_mc_mum_0_0_eventpublished&utm_term=Main_EventPublishedSubPaid_HeroSummary_other+feature+usage&utm_content=d83bc845-0544-4274-a9dd-e152eac1a1f7__6a611346d5376f10ad6add796ceee8f6__f605d558-54e9-4fbc-aef1-2c09bcef5c27) ⚖️


To say we are excited would be an understatement.


IEEE QW is happening right in our backyard from September 13th-18th; check out our stacked list of speakers 👀


And now for the talks and when and where they are happening (PennyLane content highlighted in blue):

To keep up to date with any timetable changes, make sure to check the[IEEE website](https://qce.quantum.ieee.org/2026/) and sign up for the event app. You can also use the IEEE event app to "star" sessions and receive notifications for those you want to attend.


## Meet the Team


Come meet us IRL! We'll be hanging out at the inaugural IEEE QW Canadian Quantum Village (CQV) within the IEEE QW Exhibits 🍁—a space dedicated to fostering discovery and connection within Canada's quantum community. Come say hello, grab some swag, and meet the scientists behind our work.


During the break at our[Preparing for Fault-Tolerant Applications by Programming with PennyLane](https://pennylane.ai/workshop/qce26-pennylane-tutorial) , **at 2:35 PM sharp on Monday September 14th in room 717A, we are snapping a group photo of all PennyLane users** ! If you've used PennyLane even once, yes, that is YOU. We are also handing out exclusive swag during this time, so don't miss out 📸


[Register for IEEE Quantum Week](https://qce.quantum.ieee.org/2026/registration/) .


## QHack 2026


The fun doesn't end when the clock strikes October. The rumors are true: our highly anticipated event, QHack, is back! Mark your calendars for the QHack Coding Challenge Championship running from October 16th-23rd. Up for grabs this year is USD $67 GRAND worth of cash prizes 🤯


Stay connected before registration opens on August 24th and[sign up for our QHack email list](https://mailchi.mp/qhack/2026-mailing-list) .


## Learn More and Stay Connected


Want to learn more about IWQC and QRE?[Head over to the Xanadu blog](https://www.xanadu.ai/blog/join-us-at-ieee-quantum-week-2026-iwqc-qre-and-beyond) where you'll find more details.


Want first dibs on all the latest in open-source updates, events, demos, tech breakthroughs and community highlights?[Sign up for our PennyLane newsletter](https://bit.ly/4w7zk2h) .


This fall is going to be amazing.


Until next time 🫡


-The PennyLane team
